summary: Both tokens confirm the existing regret sense and are already the only examples in their respective boxes. No new example, sense, box or collocation is warranted.
Retained the glossary's I classification. Four written root consonants or Arabic V etymology do not by themselves authorize changing the Turoyo stem to Q or its voice to Detransitive.

Experiencer is the subject. Infectum has ʕal-marked affected person and ki-clause cause; Preterit has subsequent propositional content about the speaker's role in a killing. Prospective/conditional English interpretation does not add -wa morphology.

Editors: should the inherited I label for this Arabic-derived paradigm remain, or is Q preferable under the project's stem conventions? The supplied two already-quoted forms do not settle this; no structural change is proposed.
